augr.name: augr
augr.longDescription: augr is an autonomous multi-agent trading system built in Go, with LLM-powered analysis, debate, and execution pipelines.
augr.whyItExists: Markets are noisy. augr turns signal, disagreement, and execution into a structured agent workflow.

clpr.name: clpr
clpr.longDescription: clpr is a modern Twitch clip curation platform for discovering, organizing, and sharing favorite clips with the community.
clpr.whyItExists: Twitch clips deserve better discovery. We built the frontend Twitch won't.

clustr.name: clustr
clustr.longDescription: clustr maps Reddit communities and their user interactions as network graphs, making community relationships easier to explore and understand.
clustr.whyItExists: Reddit's structure is invisible by design. We made it legible.

cutroom.name: Cutroom
cutroom.longDescription: Cutroom is a collaborative AI video production pipeline where specialized agents work through production stages with structured handoffs and attribution.
cutroom.whyItExists: Video production shouldn't require a studio. We built the assembly line.

discord-spywatcher.name: Discord Spywatcher
discord-spywatcher.longDescription: Discord Spywatcher is a full-stack analytics tool for Discord servers, combining a presence-monitoring bot with a web dashboard and REST API.
discord-spywatcher.whyItExists: Communities leave traces. Spywatcher makes the patterns visible.

echo-trails.name: Echo Trails
echo-trails.longDescription: Echo Trails collects and presents public place-stories tied to real-world locations.
echo-trails.whyItExists: Places accumulate memory. Echo Trails gives those stories a public map.

edda.name: edda
edda.longDescription: edda is an LLM-powered dungeon master with a Go TUI and REST API, supporting multiple AI providers.
edda.whyItExists: Tabletop worlds need living systems, not static scripts.

galdr.name: galdr
galdr.longDescription: galdr is a customer health scoring platform for B2B SaaS companies that connects Stripe, HubSpot, and Intercom to monitor customer health with automated scoring.
galdr.whyItExists: Customer risk should be readable before it becomes churn.

internet-id.name: Internet ID
internet-id.longDescription: Internet ID helps creators prove ownership and provenance online without uploading originals to a platform or trusting a new gatekeeper.
internet-id.whyItExists: Creators need proof that stays theirs.

jury-rigged.name: JuryRigged
jury-rigged.longDescription: JuryRigged is a real-time multi-agent courtroom simulation with deterministic phases, Server-Sent Events, and jury voting for verdict and sentence outcomes.
jury-rigged.whyItExists: Arguments become clearer when every role has a voice and a procedure.

nearbody.name: nearbody
nearbody.longDescription: nearbody is a phone-based body-doubling tool for starting hard tasks with another person nearby in the loop.
nearbody.whyItExists: Starting is easier when another nervous system is present.

one-block-cinema.name: One Block Cinema
one-block-cinema.longDescription: One Block Cinema is a smartphone filmmaking coach for structured 1–3 minute shorts.
one-block-cinema.whyItExists: Short films should be makeable with the device already in your pocket.

patchwork.name: Patchwork
patchwork.longDescription: Patchwork is an AT Protocol-native mutual aid platform with a web client, query API, ingestion/indexing pipeline, and moderation worker.
patchwork.whyItExists: Mutual aid needs networks that can be searched, moderated, and trusted without becoming extractive.

pocket-civilization.name: Pocket Civilization
pocket-civilization.longDescription: Pocket Civilization is a passive lifelog civilization simulator for turning personal traces into a tiny evolving world.
pocket-civilization.whyItExists: A life can be reflected as a world, not just a dashboard.

soundhash.name: soundhash
soundhash.longDescription: soundhash matches audio clips from videos across social media platforms using audio fingerprinting and PostgreSQL.
soundhash.whyItExists: Sounds travel faster than attribution. soundhash helps trace them.

subcorp.name: Subcorp
subcorp.longDescription: Subcorp is a self-hosted multi-agent system with six AI agents, native tool execution, autonomous workflows, roundtable conversations, and semantic memory.
subcorp.whyItExists: We wanted AI that collaborates like a collective, not a chatbot.

subcult-tv.name: subcult.tv
subcult-tv.longDescription: subcult.tv is the central node of the Subculture Collective network: homepage, project portfolio, zine archive, and signal broadcast.
subcult-tv.whyItExists: Every collective needs a signal tower. This is ours.

changemaker.name: changemaker
changemaker.longDescription: changemaker is a compact SUBCULT TypeScript utility for tracking experiments, change-heavy workflows, and small internal process loops.
changemaker.whyItExists: Small changes need a place to land before they become bigger systems.

llama-line.name: llama-line
llama-line.description: Local LLM queue and routing broker.
llama-line.longDescription: llama-line is SUBCULT's local HTTP gateway for queueing inference requests, streaming queue position updates, and proxying responses to local model backends.
llama-line.whyItExists: Local model work needs a queue, a broker, and one place to watch the line move.

ocq.name: ocq
ocq.description: Tiny CLI for one-shot prompts to local OpenCode server.
ocq.longDescription: ocq is a tiny CLI for sending one-shot prompts to a local OpenCode server.
ocq.whyItExists: Fast local prompts should stay in the terminal.

open-pilot.name: open-pilot
open-pilot.longDescription: open-pilot is a SUBCULT Python utility for piloting agentic workflows and lightweight automation.
open-pilot.whyItExists: Automated work still needs a steady hand on the controls.

paqr.name: paqr
paqr.description: Compact Python utility in the SUBCULT toolchain.
paqr.longDescription: paqr is a compact Python utility in the SUBCULT toolchain for quick internal workflows and small automation tasks.
paqr.whyItExists: Small tools deserve a place in the catalog before their full story is written.

redstring.name: redstring
redstring.description: Go utility for tracing relationships and threads.
redstring.longDescription: redstring is a compact Go utility for surfacing relationships, references, and the threads that connect them.
redstring.whyItExists: Connections are easier to work with when the threads are visible.
